members.name: routing_v5
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which topic best describes what the customer needs?

criteria.card_ordering: Ordering or getting a new, replacement, additional/spare or physical card; which card type (Visa or Mastercard) they will get; getting a card in their country
criteria.card_delivery: When a card that was ordered will arrive, delivery time, tracking a card delivery, card not yet received
criteria.card_activation_linking: Activating a new card, linking/adding a card to the app, making a card show up in the app, re-adding a found card
criteria.card_expiring: Card about to expire or expired, renewing a card
criteria.virtual_disposable_card: Getting a virtual or disposable virtual card, limits or usage of virtual/disposable cards, virtual card not working
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, contactless not working, card declined for payments or purchases, card declined at an ATM, unable to withdraw cash, card frozen?
criteria.pending_card_payment_or_withdrawal: A card payment or ATM cash withdrawal still showing as pending or not yet gone through
criteria.card_acceptance_atm: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs can be used, card spending or daily card limits
criteria.apple_google_pay: Anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay or Google Play, including how to top up or add money with them
criteria.supported_top_up_methods: Which cards, card brands (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), currencies or methods are accepted or not accepted for topping up / adding money (except Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.unrecognised_transaction: A card payment, cash withdrawal, direct debit or other transaction the customer did not make or does not recognise; unexpected money appearing in the account that they did not put there; wanting to dispute or cancel a debit card or direct debit transaction; someone else using their card or account
criteria.lost_stolen_compromised_card: Lost or stolen card, card may be compromised, need to freeze a card because of suspicious activity
criteria.lost_stolen_phone: Lost or stolen phone, protecting the app after losing the phone
criteria.passcode_pin: App passcode forgotten or not working, resetting the passcode, changing or updating an existing card PIN, PIN blocked, locked or not accepted
criteria.find_pin: Where to find, get or receive the PIN for their card, PIN not received yet, when the PIN is set up
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / took the card
criteria.charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for the same purchase
criteria.refund: Requesting a refund, cancelling a purchase, refund not showing up, returning an item, goods not received from a merchant
criteria.reverted_payment: A card payment or payment that was reverted, returned, or cancelled by the app or bank
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_applied: Wrong or unfair exchange rate, or incorrect exchange charges, applied to a specific purchase, cash withdrawal or currency exchange they made
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM gave out less or a different amount of cash than requested
criteria.specific_extra_charge: An unexplained extra charge or unknown amount on their statement that they want explained or fixed, when it is not described as a fee for a card payment, ATM withdrawal, transfer or top-up
criteria.atm_fee: A fee charged for cash withdrawals / using an ATM, or whether withdrawals cost money
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee or extra charge added for paying by card or for a purchase, including purchases from another country
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer, whether transfers or receiving money are free
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee for topping up / adding money (by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque)
criteria.exchange_rates_and_currency: How exchange rates are set, current rates, exchange fees, exchanging currency in the app, which currencies are supported for holding or exchanging
criteria.card_fees: Fees for ordering or replacing cards
criteria.transfer_not_arrived: A bank transfer that is pending, slow, or not received by the recipient; how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_failed_declined: A transfer that failed or was declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or correcting a transfer / payment sent to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or payments (including in another currency), transferring money into the account from another bank, SWIFT, how to add money by bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_problem: A top-up that failed, is pending, was reverted/pulled back, or money added that doesn't show
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up (by card, cash, cheque, bank transfer; not Apple Pay / Google Pay), top-up limits, automatic top-up
criteria.identity_verification: Verifying identity: what documents are needed, why it is needed, verification not working
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying the source of funds / money
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification check for a top-up
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Not allowed to transfer to a particular account, recipient, beneficiary or exchange; unable to add a payee
criteria.account_eligibility: Age limit, which countries are supported for the account/service

members.name: routing_v5b
members.instructions: You are routing a message from a customer of a digital bank. Pick the option that best matches what the customer is asking for or reporting.

criteria.card_ordering: The customer wants a card: a new, replacement, extra or physical card, which card brand (Visa/Mastercard) they get, or card availability in their country
criteria.card_delivery: The customer is waiting for a card to arrive: delivery times, tracking, card has not come yet
criteria.card_activation_linking: The customer wants to activate a card or add/link a card to the app (including re-adding a card they found)
criteria.card_expiring: The customer's card is expiring or has expired and they want a new one
criteria.virtual_disposable_card: The customer asks about virtual or disposable virtual cards: getting one, their limits or number of uses, or one not working
criteria.card_not_working: The customer's card does not work: contactless fails, card payments or purchases are declined, card declined at an ATM or cash cannot be withdrawn
criteria.pending_card_payment_or_withdrawal: A card payment or ATM withdrawal the customer made is still pending or has not gone through yet
criteria.card_acceptance_atm: The customer asks where the card can be used, which ATMs accept it, or card spending limits
criteria.apple_google_pay: The customer mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or Google Play (including topping up with them)
criteria.supported_top_up_methods: The customer asks which cards, card brands (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), currencies or methods can or cannot be used to add money / top up (other than Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.unrecognised_transaction: The customer sees a payment, withdrawal, direct debit or other transaction they did not make or recognise, money in their account they did not add, or wants to dispute/cancel a debit card or direct debit transaction; someone else is using their card or account
criteria.lost_stolen_compromised_card: The customer's card is lost, stolen or possibly compromised, or they want to freeze it due to suspicious activity
criteria.lost_stolen_phone: The customer lost their phone or it was stolen, or wants to secure the app after losing it
criteria.passcode_pin: The customer forgot or cannot use the app passcode, wants to reset it, wants to change or update their existing card PIN, or their PIN is blocked, locked or rejected
criteria.find_pin: The customer does not have or cannot find their card PIN, asks where to get or receive it, or when it is set up
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, took or swallowed the customer's card
criteria.charged_twice: The customer was charged twice or sees a duplicate charge for one purchase
criteria.refund: The customer wants a refund, to cancel a purchase or return an item, their refund is not showing, or goods from a merchant never arrived
criteria.reverted_payment: A card payment or other payment of theirs was reverted, returned, or cancelled by the app or bank
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_applied: The customer thinks a wrong exchange rate or incorrect exchange charges were applied to a specific purchase, cash withdrawal or currency exchange they made
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than the customer requested
criteria.specific_extra_charge: The customer sees an unexplained extra charge or unknown amount on their statement and wants it explained or fixed (not a fee described as being for a card payment, ATM withdrawal, transfer or top-up)
criteria.atm_fee: The customer asks about or complains of a fee for withdrawing cash or using an ATM
criteria.card_payment_fee: The customer asks about or complains of a fee or extra charge for paying by card or for a purchase, including foreign purchases
criteria.transfer_fee: The customer asks about or complains of a fee for a transfer, or whether sending or receiving money is free
criteria.top_up_fee: The customer asks about a fee for topping up or adding money by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque
criteria.exchange_rates_and_currency: The customer asks how exchange rates are set, what the rates are, exchange fees, exchanging currency in the app, or which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.card_fees: The customer asks what it costs to order or replace a card
criteria.transfer_not_arrived: A bank transfer is pending, slow or not received by the recipient, or the customer asks how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_failed_declined: A transfer the customer tried to make failed or was declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or correct a transfer, or sent money to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: The customer asks about receiving money or payments (including in another currency) or moving money into the account from another bank, SWIFT, or adding money by bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated: The balance has not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_problem: A top-up failed, is pending, was reverted or pulled back, or added money is not showing
criteria.top_up_how: The customer asks how to top up (card, cash, cheque, bank transfer; not Apple Pay / Google Pay), about top-up limits, or automatic top-up
criteria.identity_verification: The customer asks about identity verification: which documents, why it is needed, or it is not working
criteria.source_of_funds: The customer asks about verifying the source of their funds / money
criteria.verify_top_up: The customer asks about a verification code or verification check for a top-up
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer is not allowed to transfer to a particular account, recipient, beneficiary or exchange, or cannot add a payee
criteria.account_eligibility: The customer asks about the age limit or which countries the account or service is available in
criteria.personal_details: The customer wants to edit or change their personal details
criteria.close_account: The customer wants to close or delete their account
